title: What the Land Hears
summary: The Quiet Winter, chapter two. She asks the valley what it is doing. He plays in the answer. She decides not to tell him — yet.

scenes.visual: Very wide shot of the valley under snow, the falls half glass, the lake dark among white banks. Nothing moves. Static camera.
Extreme wide shot. The princess stands alone before the frozen falls, small against the ice, quite still. Static camera.
Close shot. The princess's face against the pale light, speaking low, the way one speaks in a church. Static camera.

dialogue.line: I know you are listening. You have always listened. My grandmother sang to you and you turned the spring warm for her, so do not pretend to be only weather with me.

scenes.visual: Very wide shot of the golden gateway beneath the mountain, snow settling on the knotwork, the lamp still burning warm inside the cold. Static camera.
Close shot. The princess's face. The answer has arrived and it is the one she feared. Static camera.

dialogue.line: So it is not a sickness of the land. It is a faithfulness. You are only saying back what one of us keeps saying quietly into you.

scenes.visual: Extreme wide shot. The warrior tramps a long line of footprints across the white valley, small in the frame, entirely happy. Static camera.
Close shot. The warrior's face flushed with cold, grinning, snow in his beard. Static camera.

dialogue.line: I walked to the far shore and back and my footprints were still there waiting for me. Do you know how long it is since anything I did stayed done?

scenes.visual: Close shot. The princess's face, studying him while he is too pleased to notice. Static camera.

dialogue.line: You sound like a man describing his own country. You have not sounded like that in three hundred years. It suits you, and it frightens me.

scenes.visual: Wide two shot. The two of them a few paces apart in the snow, breath showing, the whitened valley enormous around them. Static camera.
Close shot. The warrior's face, the grin softening into something older. Static camera.

dialogue.line: Frightens you. Snow. The woman who rode a horse across the open sea is frightened of weather that melts on your hand.

scenes.visual: Close shot. The princess's face. She could say it now. The moment is exactly here, and she watches it pass. Static camera.

dialogue.line: Not of the snow. Of what I would have to do about it if it ever stopped being beautiful. Leave me my riddles — you keep yours.

scenes.visual: Extreme wide shot. The princess walks away toward the frozen falls, small in the white, her track straight as a rule. Static camera.
Close shot. The princess's face alone, cold light, the door behind her eyes firmly shut now. Static camera.

dialogue.line: If I tell him, he will spend every hour guarding his own heart for my sake, and that is not a guest, that is a prisoner who loves his gaoler. Let it snow.

scenes.visual: Very wide shot of the valley, the snowfall thicker now, the light a shade colder than the last time we saw it. Static camera.
